userInputText: Sort, stack, and organize colorful rings in this fun & addictive puzzle game! Stack N Sort – The Ultimate Sorting Puzzle Challenge! Get ready for a super satisfying and brain-teasing puzzle experience! In Stack N Sort, your goal is to sort and stack colorful rings onto the correct poles. Sounds simple? Think again! With limited space and tricky arrangements, you’ll need sharp logic and smart moves to complete each level. How to Play: Tap & drag to move rings between poles! Stack rings of the same color together Plan your moves carefully – Limited
